llm_notes:
1. **Rewrite the page title and H1 around the highest-value comparison intent.**  
   - Title: **AeroGarden Bounty vs Bounty Basic vs Elite: Which 9-Pod Garden Is Best?**  
   - H1: **AeroGarden Bounty Comparison: Bounty vs Basic vs Elite**  
   - Add a short opening paragraph answering the query immediately: “The Bounty is the best all-rounder for most apartments; Bounty Basic is the lower-cost option; Elite is for shoppers prioritizing premium controls and finish.”  
   - Add “Bounty vs Harvest” as a secondary section rather than forcing every model into the title.

2. **Ship one scannable comparison table above the fold.**  
   Include rows for:
   - Pod capacity
   - LED wattage
   - Maximum grow height
   - Display and controls
   - Wi-Fi/app support
   - Vacation mode
   - Water and plant-food reminders
   - Best for
   - Typical price range
   - Current availability  
   
   Use verified specifications: the current Bounty listing shows 9 pods, a 40W LED, Wi-Fi compatibility, touchscreen controls, vacation mode, and a grow height up to 24 inches.[1] Bounty Basic listings describe 9 pods, a 30W LED, automatic reminders, and no touchscreen or Wi-Fi.[4][8] Mark uncertain or retailer-dependent fields as “varies by retailer/model year” instead of guessing.

3. **Add an FAQ targeting the exact GSC query variants.**  
   Use visible questions as H2/H3 headings and concise answers:
   - “Is the AeroGarden Bounty better than the Bounty Basic?”
   - “What is the difference between AeroGarden Bounty and Bounty Elite?”
   - “AeroGarden Bounty vs Harvest: which should I buy?”
